_comment: Copy this file to tools/conversation-filter.local.json and edit it.
The copy is git-ignored, so the names of any other project never enter
includeDirs - extra directories whose sessions belong to this project's
story (for example the prototype it grew out of).
drop        - plain strings; any paragraph or tool call containing one
of them is removed from the transcript entirely.
redact      - plain path rewrites, applied to whatever survives.
